title: GET /api/notifications — list user notifications
description: Return notifications for the authenticated user, with unread count and pagination.
acceptanceCriteria: Returns notifications ordered by created_at DESC
Excludes snoozed notifications where snoozed_until > NOW()

steps.description: Create notifications router and GET / handler
steps.details: Create server/src/routes/notifications.ts. GET /: 1) Build query: WHERE user_id = userId AND (snoozed_until IS NULL OR snoozed_until < NOW()). 2) If unreadOnly=true, add AND is_read = false. 3) ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 50. 4) Count unread (separate query). 5) Return { notifications, unreadCount }.
Create 3 notifications (1 read, 2 unread). GET all — verify 3 returned, unreadCount = 2. GET ?unreadOnly=true — verify 2 returned.
